title: Journal paper or conference presentation (master's)
key: A thesis-related paper or an international oral presentation
rule: By the day the result of your master's thesis examination is reported, meet at least one of the two conditions below.

Condition 1: a paper related to your thesis, as first author or corresponding author, published in a KCI-listed Korean journal or an SCIE/SCOPUS-listed international journal; or documents proving that it will be published, submitted to the department office.
Condition 2: an oral presentation, as first author or corresponding author, of a paper related to your thesis at an international conference.
For condition 2 the conference must have presenters from 4 or more countries and 20 or more oral presentations in total, and the 3 examiners must recognise it as an international conference.
For military-commissioned students (군 위탁 교육생), a presentation at a military-related conference is not recognised.

title: Journal papers for the doctoral thesis examination
key: 2 SCIE papers, or 1 paper in a top 25% (Q1) journal
rule: To have your doctoral thesis examined, meet at least one of the two conditions below while enrolled in the SNU graduate school.
Condition 1: 2 or more papers, as first author or corresponding author, in internationally recognised journals that belong to SCIE.
Condition 2: 1 or more papers, as first author or corresponding author, in an international journal in the top 25% (Q1) of the SJR or JCR classification you choose.

title: Public presentation and thesis grade (master's)
key: Presentation 2.5 of 5; thesis grade B; oral examination 60
rule: The public presentation of the thesis is held in June or December.

The public presentation is passed with an examiners' score of 2.5 or higher out of 5.
The thesis grade must be B or higher and the oral examination 60 or higher to pass.
